# PDF.js 6.3.289

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/pdfjs-dist/v/6.3.289
Upstream: https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js
License: Apache-2.0; see LICENSE and asset-specific licenses in the subdirectories.

Unmodified files extracted from `npm pack pdfjs-dist@6.3.289`:
`legacy/build/pdf.mjs`, `legacy/build/pdf.worker.mjs`, `cmaps/`,
